scope: Actual post-master instrumental mix; original drums+bass+other recombined by the app. Melody guide excluded in both comparisons.
caveats: Relative band powers are level-normalized; dynamics and level are separate measurements.
Stem bleed is not instrument ground truth. Recombining three stems can retain vocal leakage and separation artifacts.
REC/seek times have small encoding and control delays; this is not sample-aligned waveform fidelity.
A quiet interval can be musical: check against the original before calling it a dropout.
No listening-quality score, pitch/chord accuracy claim, or physical iPhone measurement.
Up/down and automatic rock muting are interpretations of detected notes, not measured picking-hand movements. The supplied still screenshot has no reference audio.
The isolated test renders existing physical PCM through the production amp with no room; its silence threshold is amplitude 0.0001 and is not perceptual T60.
No added score attacks, score pitch edits, DSP/amp changes, audio assets or per-voice effects in this release.
